phases.title: Phase 0 - Lock Current Proof Baseline
phases.scoreTarget: Baseline validation commands pass and known limits are explicit.
phases.nextAction: Keep this baseline immutable unless a new baseline proof packet is generated.

phases.title: Phase 1 - Adversarial Fixture League
phases.scoreTarget: 50 fixtures, 0 critical false accepts, <=5% false rejects, >=90% actionable next prompts.
phases.nextAction: Keep fixture failures converted into regression cases before broad rollout.

phases.title: Phase 2 - STAX Self-Dogfood League
phases.scoreTarget: 20 eligible observer runs, 0 critical false accepts, <=10% false rejects, >=90% protocol and next-prompt rates.
phases.nextAction: Proceed to measured soft-gate trial only after misses are in regression tests.

phases.title: Phase 3 - Claim Extraction Hardening
phases.scoreTarget: 100 claim-evasion fixtures, 0 high-risk false negatives, <=10% false positives, 0 unsupported accepts.
phases.nextAction: Use Phase 3 as a prerequisite for soft-gate trials.

phases.title: Phase 4 - Soft-Gate Trial
phases.scoreTarget: 50 soft-gate runs, 0 high-risk false accepts, <=5% false rejects for build/test/typecheck, <=20% overrides.
phases.nextAction: Finish the dogfood league, then run measured soft-gate trials with an override ledger.

phases.title: Phase 5 - Product Surface Amputation
phases.scoreTarget: Public surface <=6 commands and cold-user demo/docs prove the narrowed product story.
phases.nextAction: Map public/internal/archive commands, then shrink the visible product path without deleting internal capability.

phases.title: Phase 6 - Limited Hard Gate
phases.scoreTarget: Hard gate only protected boundaries after 50+ soft-gate runs across 3+ repos.
phases.nextAction: Do not turn on hard gate until soft-gate trial evidence and boundary policies pass.

nextAction: All rollout phases have passed their deterministic gates.
